title: calliandra quetzal
intro: Calliandra quetzal, commonly known as the Mexican bird of paradise, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra quetzal include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, due to its ability to reduce fever and promote sweating.
